subject.title: Add external event hooks for quota and provider state changes

question: Should CodexBar support user-configured external command execution for quota and provider events as a first-party app and CLI feature?
rationale: The implementation is opt-in and substantially hardened, but code review cannot decide whether durable local command execution belongs within CodexBar's supported product and security boundary.

options.title: Accept first-party hooks
options.body: Land the feature after the argument editor preserves exact argv elements and focused compatibility validation passes.

options.title: Limit the surface
options.body: Retain explicit config and CLI management but remove the settings editor to keep the feature clearly power-user oriented.

options.title: Decline execution hooks
options.body: Keep CodexBar observation-only and leave downstream automation to consumers of existing output surfaces.

recommendation.title: Accept first-party hooks
recommendation.body: Land the feature after the argument editor preserves exact argv elements and focused compatibility validation passes.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available authority for expanding CodexBar's supported process-execution boundary.
